Learning.title: Learning Center
Learning.success: Goal committed! Check your Dashboard to track it.
Learning.a_desc: Finding the true motive, necessity, and enjoyment in everything you do.
Learning.a_content: Discover your intrinsic motivation. Why do you push yourself in school, relationships, or sports? Connect with your true joy to build resilience in life.
Learning.a_prompt: What is the true motivation behind your daily efforts? Set a goal to tap into this 'why' when facing a challenge this week.
Learning.p_desc: Connecting past coping skills to present strengths.
Learning.p_content: Visualize the challenges you've overcome in life and map those coping skills directly into your present-day strengths.
Learning.p_prompt: Identify a past coping skill that helped you through a tough time. How will you use that skill in your life today?
Learning.s_desc: Mapping the ripple effects of your behavior changes.
Learning.s_content: Every action creates a splash. Map out how your positive behaviors ripple through your family, friends, and team.
Learning.s_prompt: What is one positive behavior you plan to execute this week, and who in your life will feel the ripple effect?
Learning.e_desc: Building TLCs: Sleep, Nutrition, Stress Management.
Learning.e_content: You are the engineer of your body and mind. Build a strong foundation using Therapeutic Lifestyle Changes (TLCs).
Learning.e_prompt: Which Lifestyle Change (Sleep, Nutrition, Hydration, Stress) are you committing to improve this week, and how?

Dashboard.daily_checkin_desc: Track your sleep, nutrition, and stress to build your neuro-resilience.
